moments.text: Night infrared view over water: a long ship strung with bright lights sits at the crosshair, with a few small lights in the distance.
The sensor pans across the water past lit ships and a very bright point light with a long glare streak.
A small dark boat on the water is held just left of the crosshair.
A ship seen from above trailing a white wake; the sensor zooms in close on its deck, then back out.
Zoomed out after a flash: a faint light speck with a short trail moves down from upper left of the crosshair toward the bottom. Easy to miss.
After another flash, a tiny dark speck appears just above the crosshair and climbs to the top black box in about 0.6 s.
